verdict.rationale: The repo's skill-creator skill can 'measure skill performance' and 'benchmark skill performance with variance analysis', and can tune descriptions for triggering accuracy. That gives developers eval tooling. But nothing shows the collection itself keeps tests, evals or CI regression checks for its bundled skills (pdf, xlsx, docx, pptx, etc.). Missing for 10: per-skill test or eval suites in the repository, CI or regression gating on changes, published eval results for bundled skills, independent corroboration.
